First release of Dernity: a desktop workspace for models you host on rented GPUs.

- **Deploy with your own agent.** Built-in terminals run the agent CLIs you already have (Claude Code,
  Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, …), logged in as you. The workspace ships skills to deploy a model from
  Hugging Face, compare GPU offers on Vast.ai and RunPod, connect running servers, and redeploy from history.
- **One window for every model.** Chat for text models (OpenAI-compatible: llama.cpp, vLLM, SGLang,
  Ollama…), a generation studio for image and video models on ComfyUI. Forms follow each model's config,
  so you only see the inputs it supports: reference images, first and last frame, duration and so on.
- **Machines and history.** Balances, running and stopped instances, $/h, and a history of what ran where.
- **Local only.** Prompts, parameters and outputs stay on your machine as plain files, out of the agent's reach.

Downloads are unsigned. macOS: right-click the app and choose Open the first time. Windows: SmartScreen →
More info → Run anyway.
